      <rect x="0" y="0" width="78" height="40" fill="$accent"/>

      <rect x="-80" y="0" width="78" height="40" fill="$accent"/>

def _delayed_render(name: str, delay: float = 4.0):
    """Fetch and render in a background thread after a delay."""
    memes = _load_db()
    m = _find(memes, name)
    if not m:
        return
    time.sleep(delay)
    local = m.get("local_file")
    if local and Path(local).exists():
        _render_file(local)
        return
    gif_url = _tenor_search(m["tenor"])
    if gif_url:
        _render(gif_url)

1. **Strict alignment** — set `palette.stroke1/2/3 = data.cat[0..2]` everywhere. Cleanest semantically; flattens gastown's brown ramp to brass+sage+rust, minimal's stroke to blue+green+amber, lab's neon to pastel. ~5 min.

def find_meme(situation: str) -> str:
    """Find matching memes by situation description. Returns top 3 results with name,
    deploy_when, and text_dependent (~120 tokens). Use this instead of list_memes when
    you have a situation in mind — it's ~25x cheaper."""
    memes = _load_db()
    query_tokens = _tokenize(situation)
    ...
    scored = sorted(memes, key=lambda m: len(query_tokens & _meme_corpus(m)), reverse=True)
    top = [m for m in scored if len(query_tokens & _meme_corpus(m)) > 0][:3]

<svg width="420" height="160" viewBox="0 0 420 160" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Comedian fear bar (left) -->
  <rect x="60" y="20" width="36" height="120" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="$muted" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Fear fill: decays from full (120) to near-zero over 3s -->
  <rect x="60" y="20" width="36" rx="4" fill="$accent" opacity="0.85">
    <animate attributeName="height" values="120;8;120" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.6 0 0.4 1; 0.6 0 0.4 1"/>
    <animate attributeName="y" values="20;132;20" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.6 0 0.4 1; 0.6 0 0.4 1"/>
  </rect>

  <!-- Signal propagation line -->
  <line x1="96" y1="80" x2="324" y2="80" stroke="$stroke1" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
  <!-- Traveling dot along the propagation path, DERIVED from "signal propagates" with lag -->
  <circle r="5" fill="$stroke1" opacity="0.9">
    <animateMotion dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" keyTimes="0;0.35;0.65;1" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.4 0 0.6 1;0.4 0 0.6 1;0.4 0 0.6 1">

    </animateMotion>
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="96;96;324;324" keyTimes="0;0.35;0.65;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.4 0 0.6 1;0.4 0 0.6 1;0.4 0 0.6 1"/>
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="80;80;80;80" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;1;0" keyTimes="0;0.1;0.6;0.7" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- Audience tension bar (right), same decay but phase-shifted to encode lag -->
  <rect x="324" y="20" width="36" height="120" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="$muted" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Tension fill: same shape as fear but delayed ~0.35 of cycle -->
  <rect x="324" width="36" rx="4" fill="$stroke2" opacity="0.85">
    <!-- begin offset by ~1.4s (0.35 * 4s) to encode propagation lag -->
    <animate attributeName="height" values="120;8;120" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="4s" begin="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.6 0 0.4 1; 0.6 0 0.4 1"/>
    <animate attributeName="y" values="20;132;20" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="4s" begin="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" calcMode="spline" keySplines="0.6 0 0.4 1; 0.6 0 0.4 1"/>
  </rect>

  <!-- Mic stand icon between bars (static, semantic) -->
  <circle cx="210" cy="72" r="9" fill="none" stroke="$fg" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="210" y1="81" x2="210" y2="108" stroke="$fg" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="198" y1="108" x2="222" y2="108" stroke="$fg" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <line x1="210" y1="108" x2="204" y2="122" stroke="$fg" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="210" y1="108" x2="216" y2="122" stroke="$fg" stroke-width="1.4"/>
</svg>
cells.caption: Comedian fear decays (left bar, $accent) → signal travels across stage → audience tension drops in sync but delayed (right bar, $stroke2). The phase offset between the two bars is the propagation lag: confidence reads before the audience feels it.
cells.classifier_reasoning: The snippet describes a two-bar animation where comedian fear decays, then signal propagates to audience, whose tension drops in sync — the lag between bars encodes propagation delay. Motion across time is the load-bearing claim: the *sequence* and *offset* between the two bars is what the cell must show. A static vega bar chart could show the values but loses the temporal propagation and lag; animated_svg shows the decay and sync dynamics tick-by-tick, which is exactly the "process unfolding" shape.
cells.title: Fear-to-audience tension propagation lag

cells.trigger_snippet:
Rapid successive drops are worse than no drops. We implement a decaying threshold inspired by MemeCMD [1]:

```
θ(t) = e^(−λ · elapsed_min),  λ = 0.5
```

Half-life: ~1.4 minutes. Effectively clear: ~6 minutes. Threshold state is bucketed into `tight` (θ > 0.7), `moderate` (0.25 < θ ≤ 0.7), and `clear` (θ ≤ 0.25) and returned to the model in the `drop_meme` response.

spec.source:
def _api_call(client, model, prompt, max_tokens=20):
    """Call API with disk cache — temperature=0 results are deterministic."""
    cached = _cache_get(model, prompt)
    if cached is not None:
        return cached
    msg = client.messages.create(
        model=model,
        max_tokens=max_tokens,
        temperature=0,
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
    )
    if not msg.content or not hasattr(msg.content[0], "text"):
        raise ValueError(f"unexpected API response: {msg.content!r}")
    pick = msg.content[0].text.strip().split("\n")[0].strip()
    _cache_set(model, prompt, pick)
    return pick

    Never drop text_dependent=true memes.
